instruction: Cinematic medium shot inside an indoor boxing ring. On the left, the woman in the black and orange jumpsuit (R1) stands facing right, holding up a red focus mitt to absorb a blow. On the right, the woman in the white sports bra (R2) stands facing left, her left arm fully extended as her black boxing glove impacts the mitt of the woman in the black and orange jumpsuit. The background shows dark hanging punching bags under cool, dim overhead gym lighting.
elements: R1 holds up a red focus mitt to absorb R2's blow
R2 punches the focus mitt held by R1 with a black boxing glove
R1 is the mitt holder while R2 is the striker in the boxing drill
indoor boxing ring with dark hanging punching bags
